name: quantity-trust-checklist
description: Known wall/opening numbers for Draft→ShilpiDB→CoreOp quantity trust. Asserted by crates/engine/tests/quantity_trust.rs and mirrored in O-CoreOp CadImport.Tests.

expected_face_m2.note: CadImport stores length/height/thickness and opening deduct rows; net face m² is the QS checklist number (length_m×height_m − Σ opening_w×opening_h).

regressions_caught: re-record same drawing → same wall/opening counts (no double rows)
second drawing same project_ref + Ground → double-count warning
opening far from walls → missing wall_ref + warning
MEASURE-FULLBRICK without A-WALL faces → thickness 230 + nominal _note
